title: URL userinfo password that itself contains a colon
summary: A synthetic URL whose userinfo password contains a second colon.
rationale: Only the first colon delimits user from password; the rest, up to the at-sign, belongs to the password. A span that stops at the second colon leaks the tail.

expectation.rationale: Flag, with everything after the first colon up to the at-sign as the extent. RFC 3986 says applications should not render as clear text any data after the first colon.

sources.supports: Applications should not render as clear text any data after the first colon.
